description: T1 (tt-charter-template-and-spend-ledger): the checked-in template a run charter is MECHANICALLY BOUND to, not merely copied from. charter.cjs's createCharter() loads this file, stamps template_id and template_sha256 into the charter it emits, and REFUSES any spec whose allowed_write_surfaces drops a mandated_write_surfaces entry (TEMPLATE-SURFACE-DROPPED) or whose ceilings fall below the recorded floors (TEMPLATE-CEILING-UNDERSIZED). This closes the exact way gen-1's write-surface omission (missing tools/ant-hive-world/unreal-export/**, the projection payload + deploy-ledger surface every cycle writes) silently propagated into gen-2's charter: charters had been copied run-to-run with no mechanism checking the copy against a canonical source.

derivation.note: Documentation, not enforcement: createCharter() strips this field before computing template_sha256, so an edit to this prose never changes the template's binding identity -- only mandated_write_surfaces, min_max_cumulative_diff, and min_max_external_actions are load-bearing.
derivation.counting_rule: git diff --stat over the measured interval for distinct files touched and total changed lines, plus the journalled external-actions ledger value for the same interval.
derivation.source: codex-cli-run__20260814T0348Z__tt-charter-template-v5-final.md and the plan's amended_v5 changelog; reviewer-computed values adopted verbatim.
